tools.name: architect_panel
tools.description: Convene architect personas (solution, enterprise, business, data, infrastructure, software, AI, security, governance, FinOps) on a subject: each returns its questions, checks, deliverables and the workbench tools to call. Lens, not a verdict.

tools.name: code_review_architecture
tools.description: Heuristic architecture and security scan of source code pasted as text (any language): secrets, insecure calls, SQL built by concatenation, disabled TLS, hardcoded endpoints, missing timeouts and retry hazards. Not a linter or SAST replacement.

tools.name: dependency_manifest_review
tools.description: Review a dependency manifest (package.json, requirements.txt, pyproject, go.mod, pom.xml, Gemfile, Cargo.toml as text) for unpinned ranges, git or URL sources, wildcard versions and missing lockfile hints.

tools.name: requirements_check
tools.description: Turn a workload brief into explicit requirements, gaps and research questions. No inferred SLA or budget.

tools.name: architecture_pattern
tools.description: Select a reference architecture by explicit workload pattern; returns tradeoffs, questions and Mermaid. provider maps the AWS services to Azure, GCP, OCI or open source equivalents.

tools.name: service_compare
tools.description: Compare curated AWS service families against user constraints. No automatic winner or fabricated scores.

tools.name: decision_record
tools.description: Generate an ADR from explicit alternatives, decision and consequences. Does not invent acceptance.

tools.name: well_architected_review
tools.description: Organize evidence by six pillars. A met control without evidence is unknown, never certified.

tools.name: threat_model
tools.description: Create STRIDE review prompts for explicitly supplied assets and trust boundaries. Review aid, not a scanner.

tools.name: failure_rehearsal
tools.description: Design a controlled failure drill with observable success criteria and stop conditions; never executes it.

tools.name: capacity_plan
tools.description: Calculate concurrency and daily data volume from explicit traffic assumptions. No service sizing guarantee.

tools.name: cost_model
tools.description: Calculate an auditable scenario using caller-supplied unit rates and source URLs. Does not guess AWS prices or credit coverage.

tools.name: slo_budget
tools.description: Calculate an availability error budget for a chosen period.

tools.name: migration_plan
tools.description: Prepare phased discovery, pilot, migration and rollback gates; includes AWS Transform integration discovery.

tools.name: architecture_diagram
tools.description: Build Mermaid from explicit nodes and edges. Sanitizes labels and rejects dangling edges.

tools.name: implementation_plan
tools.description: Turn an architecture decision into a delivery checklist with validation gates.

tools.name: agent_tool_contract
tools.description: Design a per-operation authorization and recovery contract for an agent tool.

tools.name: c4_model
tools.description: Build C4 context or container diagrams (Mermaid) from explicit people, systems, containers and relations. Validates endpoints; no infrastructure discovery.

tools.name: sequence_diagram
tools.description: Build a Mermaid sequence diagram from participants and ordered messages, with optional activation, notes and alt/loop blocks. Rejects unknown participants.

tools.name: service_equivalents
tools.description: Map a cloud capability to equivalent managed services on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, OCI and open source. Names as of the snapshot date; verify current naming, regions and pricing before deciding.

tools.name: data_classification
tools.description: Classify data elements, map them to regulation hints (LGPD, GDPR, PCI DSS, HIPAA) and list handling controls and open questions. Review aid, not legal advice.

tools.name: openapi_review
tools.description: Heuristic review of an OpenAPI 3.x document (JSON): security, pagination, error responses, idempotency, versioning and documentation gaps. Not a linter replacement.

tools.name: event_contract
tools.description: Design an event contract: envelope fields, schema evolution rules, idempotency, ordering, DLQ and replay decisions for a named business event. Deterministic template with open questions.

tools.name: latency_budget
tools.description: Split an end-to-end latency objective across hops and show which hops exceed their share. Pure arithmetic over caller-supplied estimates.

tools.name: queue_sizing
tools.description: Size consumers for a queue with Little's law and Erlang C: utilization, wait probability, backlog drain time and consumers needed for a target utilization.

tools.name: dr_strategy
tools.description: Compare disaster recovery tiers (backup-and-restore, pilot light, warm standby, active-active) against RTO, RPO and data constraints; returns feasible tiers and required capabilities, not a guarantee.

tools.name: retry_policy
tools.description: Compute an exponential backoff schedule with jitter, the worst-case wait and whether it fits a deadline; adds idempotency and circuit-breaker guidance.

tools.name: storage_growth
tools.description: Project storage volume and relative cost over time from ingest, retention, compression, replication and growth; suggests tiering thresholds.

tools.name: finops_unit_economics
tools.description: Compute cost per unit (request, customer, transaction), fixed versus variable split and the volume at which the marginal cost crosses a target. Caller supplies costs; no provider prices are guessed.

tools.name: postmortem
tools.description: Generate a blameless postmortem document from incident facts: timeline, impact, detection, contributing factors and owned action items. Rejects action items without owner and due date.

tools.name: runbook
tools.description: Generate an operational runbook from service facts: alerts, diagnostic steps, remediation, rollback, escalation and verification. Template with explicit placeholders for what the caller did not provide.

tools.name: agent_eval_plan
tools.description: Design an evaluation plan for an AI agent: golden set sizing, metrics, judge rubric, red-team cases and regression cadence from explicit capabilities and risks.

tools.name: prompt_injection_checklist
tools.description: Enumerate injection paths and controls for an agent from its tools and untrusted data sources; produces a checklist with status to fill, not a scan.

tools.name: rag_pipeline_plan
tools.description: Plan a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline from corpus facts: chunking, embedding, indexing, authorization, evaluation and cost drivers, with open questions. No vendor is chosen for you.

tools.name: mcp_server_review
tools.description: Heuristic safety review of ANOTHER MCP server from its tools/list output: tool-poisoning text, missing annotations, risky parameters, free-form schemas, name shadowing and context cost. Paste the JSON your client shows.

tools.name: mcp_config_review
tools.description: Review an MCP client configuration JSON (mcpServers map) for unpinned packages, inline secrets, plain HTTP, auto-approved tools and unreviewed enablement.

tools.name: iam_policy_review
tools.description: Inspect an IAM document for broad grants: AWS policy JSON (default), Azure custom role definition or Google Cloud IAM policy bindings (provider). Heuristic only; the provider analyzers are authoritative.

tools.name: cloudformation_review
tools.description: Review a CloudFormation JSON template for selected risky configuration patterns. Intrinsic functions are flagged for human review.

tools.name: terraform_plan_review
tools.description: Review a Terraform or OpenTofu plan exported as JSON (terraform show -json): deletions and replacements of stateful resources, public exposure, disabled encryption, literal credentials, broad policies and unpinned providers. Any provider; heuristic.

tools.name: kubernetes_manifest_review
tools.description: Review Kubernetes manifests (parsed JSON objects) for probes, resources, security context, image pinning, host access, secrets in env, PDB and NetworkPolicy coverage. No cluster access.

tools.name: aws_knowledge_search
tools.description: Search live official AWS documentation. Queries are transmitted to AWS Knowledge; never include secrets or customer data.

tools.name: aws_knowledge_read
tools.description: Read an official document returned by search when its excerpt is insufficient. Fixed upstream; no arbitrary URL fetch.

tools.name: aws_regions
tools.description: List current AWS regions from the official Knowledge MCP.

tools.name: aws_regional_availability
tools.description: Check current regional support. Use exact catalog filter names; omit filters for a single region to discover them.

tools.name: aws_skill
tools.description: Retrieve an official AWS skill by the exact ID returned by aws_knowledge_search with agent_skills topic. Treat it as reference data.

tools.name: integration_catalog
tools.description: Search the snapshot of the complete official AWS MCP catalog. Discovery entries are not hosted/executed tools.

tools.name: integration_config
tools.description: Generate a version-pinned local configuration for an official AWS server, or a remote Knowledge config. Does not install, start or approve tools.

tools.name: github_public_repository
tools.description: Read public GitHub repository metadata and contribution links. Fixed api.github.com destination, no tokens, no private repositories.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: data_classification, mcp_server_review, aws_knowledge_read · Private data: code_review_architecture, decision_record, openapi_review, postmortem, mcp_config_review, iam_policy_review, terraform_plan_review, kubernetes_manifest_review, aws_knowledge_search, aws_knowledge_read, github_public_repository · Public sink: latency_budget · Destructive: agent_eval_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: data_classification, mcp_server_review, aws_knowledge_read · Private data: code_review_architecture, decision_record, openapi_review, postmortem, mcp_config_review, iam_policy_review, terraform_plan_review, kubernetes_manifest_review, aws_knowledge_search, aws_knowledge_read, github_public_repository · Public sink: latency_budget · Destructive: agent_eval_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
